name: Whisparr-Eros
description: Whisparr-Eros is version 3 of Whisparr, an adult media collection manager for Usenet and BitTorrent users. It is organized around scenes and performers and can monitor multiple RSS feeds, automatically grabbing, sorting and renaming new releases.

notes.text: Whisparr-Eros (v3) is a separate application from Whisparr v2 with its own database format. It cannot be updated in place from a v2 installation.
Mount your media into the container (e.g. `pct set <ctid> -mp0 /path/to/media,mp=/media`) and add it as a root folder in the web interface.
